finding: INV-1: the MCP JSON-RPC not-initialized producer still emits the guessed disjunction 'code_sandbox.enabled = false or boot probes failed' — the exact anti-pattern INV-1 forbids — on the model-facing path. Not routed through init_status().explain().
INV-1: the streaming not-initialized producer emits a vague 'code_sandbox not initialized' with no reason. Not routed through init_status().explain().

INV-3: redact_host_paths only scrubs workspace_root + rootfs mount_dir. It MISSES the other host-path families bwrap binds and names in setup-failure stderr: provider host-folder mounts (all_mounts[].host_path, e.g. /home/user/Documents) and ctx.extra_ro_binds host sources (the /lit view cache path). A dead mount of any of those leaks the host path verbatim in an isError:false result. The code comment was inaccurate.

F2: redaction is a literal str::replace of the CONFIGURED path strings, so a canonical/symlink-resolved form differing from the configured string would be missed; also a workload can read host bind-source paths from /proc/self/mountinfo. Triaged as largely out-of-scope: bwrap's OWN setup-failure stderr (the vector this fix targets) echoes the argv strings verbatim (the configured form), so the target is covered; the /proc introspection vector is pre-existing and unrelated to result-diagnostic honesty (and host paths are not secrets under the module threat model).

F3: str::replace has no minimum-specificity guard beyond non-empty, so a misconfigured short root ('/data') could over-redact legitimate output. Triaged nit: the roots are always deep resolved absolute paths from config (never a 1-segment prefix), and the only output that could contain a full host root is workload /proc introspection (not legitimate command output).

INV-2 EOF nit: a write()==0 with a STALE errno==EPIPE in thread-local would misclassify as quiet ChildGone. Both angles agree this is unreachable in practice (a pipe write of a non-zero buffer never returns 0) and the default classification of an unexpected EOF is the safe loud Truncated. No action.

F5: explain() reveals deployment posture (bwrap missing / disabled / IMDS). On the MCP tools/call path it is masked by map_tool_error; on REST paths it reaches authenticated/admin callers only. No secrets. Acceptable — and the two model-facing INV-1 fixes deliberately expose the (non-sensitive, useful) reason, consistent with the honest-diagnostics goal.
